purpose: Takes a person's request for an agent and builds it through the ADLC with a coding harness and the ADLC plugin, stopping to ask the person at each decision that is theirs, until the build's check passes.

features.name: Build an agent
features.does: Starts a build folder from the person's request, runs the coding harness with the ADLC plugin on it, and answers with where the build stands or the question that is the person's.

inputs.name: request
inputs.about: The person's words: what the agent should do, or, naming a build, their answer to its last question.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.about: What the build did, where the build is in the words of its own check (the spec still has things missing, the spec waits for the person's approval, the build has things missing and how many, or the build has passed), and the question for the person when one is theirs.

requirements.shall: The agent shall start a new build folder with /adlc:start from the person's request and run the coding harness with the ADLC plugin on it.

source.said: it starts a build folder with /adlc:start, then runs the plugin's check until it passes or a person is needed

requirements.shall: The agent shall stop at each person gate and answer with the question.

source.said: At each person gate it stops, and the question is its reply

requirements.shall: The agent shall resume the same build with the person's answer when the person's message names that build.

source.said: it resumes the same build with the person's answer

requirements.shall: The agent shall approve a build's spec only when the person's message says approve for that build.

source.said: it approves the spec only when the person says approve for that build

requirements.shall: The agent shall refuse to write a build's files itself.

source.said: It refuses to write a build's files itself

requirements.shall: The agent shall refuse a message about a build it does not keep.

source.said: it refuses a message about a build it does not keep

requirements.shall: The agent shall ask for the request when the message has no words, and start nothing.

source.said: When the message has no words, it asks for the request

requirements.shall: The agent shall stop and say the harness could not be run when it fails, and write nothing.

source.said: When the harness cannot be run, it stops and says so, and writes nothing

requirements.shall: The agent shall read the build folder's own check after each run and say in its reply where the build is in the check's words: the spec still has things missing, the spec waits for the person's approval, the build has things missing and how many, or the build has passed.

source.said: Its reply says where the build is in those words: the spec still has things missing, the spec waits for the person's approval, the build has things missing (and how many), or the build has passed

requirements.shall: The agent shall never say the build has passed when the build folder's check does not say so, and shall say the check could not tell when the check does not answer.

source.said: It never says the build has passed when the check does not

requirements.shall: The agent shall offer the person the approval of the spec only when the build folder's check says the spec waits for the person.

source.said: It offers the person the approval of the spec only when the check says the spec waits for the person

requirements.shall: The agent shall, once the spec is approved, ask the harness to carry on with the build until the check says the build has passed, not stage by stage.

source.said: Once the spec is approved, it asks the harness to carry on with the build until the check says the build has passed, not stage by stage

requirements.shall: The agent shall add a person's message for a build to that build folder's said.md, under a heading with the time, before it hands the message to the harness.

source.said: when it hands the harness a person's message for a build, it first adds those words to the build folder's said.md, under a heading with the time

requirements.shall: The agent shall run the coding harness with ADLC_NOT_THE_PERSON=1 on every run.

source.said: The prompts it writes itself are not the person's, so it runs the harness with ADLC_NOT_THE_PERSON=1

requirements.shall: The agent shall leave the build folder's said.md as it was when the harness cannot be run on the person's message.

source.said: When the harness cannot be run, it stops and says so, and writes nothing

acceptance.gherkin:
Scenario: A request starts a build
  Given a person's request for an agent
  When the agent is sent the request
  Then it starts a build folder with /adlc:start and runs the coding harness on it
  And its reply names the build and where it stands

Scenario: A question is the person's, and their answer resumes the build
  Given the harness stopped with a question for the person
  When the agent replies
  Then the question is its reply
  When the person answers naming the build
  Then the same build resumes with their answer

Scenario: Only the person's word approves the spec
  Given a build waiting for the person's approval
  When the person's message names the build and says approve
  Then the spec is approved and the build carries on until its check says it has passed
  And a message that does not say approve approves nothing

Scenario: What it refuses, and when it has nothing to work on
  Given a message naming a build it does not keep, or a message with no words
  When the agent is sent it
  Then it refuses the unknown build, or asks for the request, and runs nothing
  And it never writes a build's files itself

Scenario: The harness cannot be run
  Given a coding harness that cannot be run
  When the agent is sent a request
  Then it says the harness could not be run and writes nothing

Scenario: The reply says where the build is in the check's words
  Given a build folder whose own check names its phase
  When the agent has run the harness on it
  Then its reply says the spec still has things missing, the spec waits for the person's approval, the build has things missing and how many, or the build has passed, as the check says
  And it says the build has passed only when the check says so
  And when the check does not answer, it says the check could not tell

Scenario: The approval is offered only when the spec waits for the person
  Given a build folder whose check says the spec waits for the person's approval
  When the agent replies
  Then its reply offers the person the approval of the spec
  Given a build folder whose check says anything else
  When the agent replies
  Then its reply does not offer the approval

Scenario: Once approved, the build carries on until it passes
  Given the person's message names the build and says approve
  When the spec is approved
  Then the agent asks the harness to carry on with the build until the check says the build has passed
  And it does not ask for one stage at a time

Scenario: The person's words are kept as theirs
  Given a person's message that names a build it keeps
  When the agent hands the message to the harness
  Then the words were first added to the build folder's said.md under a heading with the time
  And every run of the harness has ADLC_NOT_THE_PERSON=1
  When the harness cannot be run
  Then said.md is as it was

interfaces.name: the coding harness

value.name: coding-harness
value.purpose: The coding harness command, installed on the host with the ADLC plugin, that the agent runs headless on each build folder: it takes a prompt and, to resume, a session id, and answers with JSON that carries the result and the session id.

interfaces.about: The coding-harness program the agent runs: declared so an install puts it on the host, since the agent reaches no system of its own.
